description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity of an Android app that generates and displays a palette of five random HSL colors. It manages UI components, handles button clicks to regenerate colors, and updates the color blocks with corresponding HSL and HEX labels.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity of the app responsible for generating and displaying a color palette. Manages UI initialization, palette rendering, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, binds UI components, and sets up initial palette rendering and button click behavior.

methods.name: renderPalette
methods.description: Updates the color tiles in the UI with a new list of HSL colors, setting their background colors and labels.
